nodes.question: What impurities are leached out from the SPL in the mentioned method?
nodes.answer: Fluoride and cyanide impurities are leached out from the SPL.
nodes.paragraph: [14,15]In this method the SPL is ground to less than 300 Im particles, uoride and cyanide impurities are leached out of the SPL and the cyanides are destructed. The carbonaceous by-product (containingabout 30 40 wt pct carbon and 60 70 wt pct SiO 2and AI2O3) has been used as construction material for Rio Tinto S bauxite residue dams and in the cement industry. The carbonaceous by-product has also been used as alternative fuel and raw material for clinker production. Better sorting between the rst and second cut SPLenables even better valorization of the by-products. Thecarbon rich part can then be used as an energy source when the carbon content reaches about 80 85 pct. Tests have also been performed using a small amount of thecarbon rich by-product in carbon anode production. [15] While using the carbon material as an energy source could be considered a down-cycling of the material, (re) using the rst cut SPL in carbon products like anodes and S derberg electrode paste is approaching reuse without down-cycling as the potential energypresent in the carbon anodes is to a large degree (morethan 80 pct) utilized for producing a valuable product such as aluminum, as to the contrary when carbon used as fuel to only produce CO 2in,e.g., a coal red powerplant with a power e ciency of up to 40 pct.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water purification techniques|Distillation methods_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What method did McGeer et al. patent in 1958?
nodes.answer: McGeer et al. patented a distillation method for recovering material from the aluminum reduction cell lining using high temperature and vacuum.
nodes.paragraph: Primary aluminum metal is a valuable virgin product but can also be considered as a power bank as it can berecycled endlessly using only a fraction of the energy when remelting compared to the electrochemical reduc- tion of alumina to producing primary aluminum metal. McGeer et al. [16]patented in 1958 a distillation method for recovering material from the aluminum reduction cell lining using high temperature and vac-uum. A distillation column was proposed, where the uorides and metallic sodium are volatilized. A succes- sively lower temperature as the vapors ascends the distillation column will allow the uorides to condensein the rst part of the path and sodium will stay in the vapor phase. In the upper part of the distillation column, the temperature will be low enough for sodiumto condense, away from the uorides. In this method the SPL does not need to be ground to very small particles prior to treatment which is an advantage as grinding istime consuming and costly in terms of investment, labor and energy demand. The foreseen end products would be sodium, cryolite and a puri ed carbon material ( rstcut SPL).

nodes.question: How does the temperature gradient in the distillation column facilitate separation of components?
nodes.answer: As the vapors ascend the distillation column, a successively lower temperature allows the fluorides to condense in the first part, while sodium remains in the vapor phase until a lower temperature allows it to condense in the upper part of the column.
